Name: Spotify Deck+
Description: Spotify controls for Stream Deck +: playback keys, a volume dial and a folder-style library browser.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.play-p.Name: Play / Pause
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.play-p.Tooltip: Shows the playback state over the album art; press to play or pause.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.like.Name: Like
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.like.Tooltip: Adds or removes the current track from Liked Songs.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.repeat.Name: Repeat
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.repeat.Tooltip: Cycles repeat off → repeat all → repeat one.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.add-to.Name: Add to Playlist
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.add-to.Tooltip: Adds the current track to the playlist chosen in the key settings.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.device.Name: Switch Device
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.device.Tooltip: Moves playback to the next Spotify Connect device on each press.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.setup.Name: Settings
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.setup.Tooltip: Opens the Spotify Deck+ settings page (login and status) in your browser.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.playba.Name: Playback
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.playba.Tooltip: Shows the current track and progress.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.volume.Name: Volume
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.volume.Tooltip: Adjusts the volume of the active Spotify device.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.browse.Name: Library Browser
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.browse.Tooltip: Browse Now Playing, queue, playlists, liked songs, artists, albums and history like folders, and play from them.

TriggerDescription.Push: Open / Play · Hold: add to queue

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.playli.Name: My Playlists
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.playli.Tooltip: Scroll through your playlists and press to play one.

com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.liked-.Name: Liked Songs
com.protomothis.spotify-deck-plus.liked-.Tooltip: Scroll through your liked songs and press to play one.
